# age recipients for the Private vault.
#
# One public key per line. Every file in this vault is encrypted to ALL of
# these keys, so any one of them can decrypt it. Add a line per device.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored, so this file is also a
# valid argument to `age -R recipients.txt`.
#
# Add your first key with:
#
#     age-keygen -o ~/.config/fjord/identity.txt
#     age-keygen -y ~/.config/fjord/identity.txt >> Private/recipients.txt
#
# Until at least one key is present, nothing can be written to this vault.
#
# Removing a key here stops FUTURE files being encrypted to it. It does not
# revoke anything: every version already in git history stays readable by
# that key forever. See "Rotating and revoking keys" in the root README.

age1r23clxd5mzfsh79vn6pg0kaytjeq8w4ur23clxd5mzfsh79vn6pg0kaytj
